# TriggerBot

**Category:** Combat  
**Aliases:** TriggerBot

## What it does

Automatically attack entities that are on your crosshair

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/TriggerBot.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
